name: ProCGroups.ContinuousMulEquiv.exists_conjugated_action
statement:
theorem exists_conjugated_action
    {Γ B H : Type*} [Group Γ] [Group B] [Group H]
    [TopologicalSpace Γ] [TopologicalSpace B] [TopologicalSpace H]
    (e₀ : B ≃ₜ* H) (R : Γ →* MulAut H)
    (hR : Continuous (fun z : Γ × H => R z.1 z.2)) (α : Γ) :
    ∃ (e : B ≃ₜ* H) (ρ : Γ →* MulAut B),
      Continuous (fun z : Γ × B => ρ z.1 z.2) ∧
      (∀ σ x, e (ρ σ x) = R σ (e x)) ∧
      ∀ x, e x = R α⁻¹ (e₀ x)

    (η : ∀ i, Y → G ⧸ (L i : Subgroup G))

    (hηcompat : ∀ {i j} (hij : i ≤ j),

    ∃ ηinf : Y → G ⧸ ((closedSubgroup_sInf L : ClosedSubgroup G) : Subgroup G),

              (L i : Subgroup G)
              (closedSubgroup_sInf_le (L := L) i) ∘ ηinf = η i) ∧

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.exists_etale_factor_prime_le_ramificationIdx_eq
statement:
theorem exists_etale_factor_prime_le_ramificationIdx_eq
    {R : Type u} {B : Type v}
    [CommRing R] [CommRing B] [Algebra R B] [Algebra.FiniteType R B]
    (p : Ideal R) [p.IsPrime]
    (q : Ideal B) [q.IsPrime] [q.LiesOver p] [Algebra.QuasiFiniteAt R q]
    (r : Ideal B) [r.IsPrime] (hrq : r ≤ q) :
    ∃ (C : Type u) (_ : CommRing C) (_ : Algebra R C) (_ : Algebra.Etale R C)
      (P : Ideal C) (_ : P.IsPrime) (_ : P.LiesOver p)
      (e : TensorProduct R C B) (_ : IsIdempotentElem e)
      (P' Q : Ideal (TensorProduct R C B))
      (_ : P'.IsPrime) (_ : P'.LiesOver P) (_ : Q.IsPrime),
        P'.comap Algebra.TensorProduct.includeRight.toRingHom = q ∧
        Q ≤ P' ∧
        Q.comap Algebra.TensorProduct.includeRight.toRingHom = r ∧
        Q.ramificationIdx C = r.ramificationIdx R ∧
        e ∉ Q ∧
        e ∉ P' ∧
        Function.Bijective
          (Ideal.ResidueField.mapₐ p P (Algebra.ofId _ _) (P.over_def p)) ∧
        Module.Finite C (Localization.Away e) ∧
        ∀ P'' : Ideal (TensorProduct R C B),
          P''.IsPrime → P''.LiesOver P → e ∉ P'' → P'' = P'

    IsRegular S (ps.map (Ideal.Quotient.mk I)) ∧

      IsRegularLocalRing C ∧
      (∀ p ∈ ps.map (algebraMap A C), Prime p) ∧

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.exists_tensorProduct_algEquiv_stage_of_filteredColimit
statement:
theorem exists_tensorProduct_algEquiv_stage_of_filteredColimit
    {R B D : Type u} [CommRing R] [CommRing B] [CommRing D]
    [Algebra R B] [Algebra R D]
    [Algebra.FinitePresentation R B]
    [Algebra.FinitePresentation R D]
    {J : Type u} [SmallCategory J] [IsFiltered J]
    (F : J ⥤ Under (CommRingCat.of R))
    (c : Cocone F) (hc : IsColimit c)
    (e : (c.pt ⊗[R] B) ≃ₐ[c.pt] (c.pt ⊗[R] D)) :
    ∃ (i : J)
      (eᵢ : (F.obj i ⊗[R] B) ≃ₐ[F.obj i] (F.obj i ⊗[R] D)),
      (filteredTensorToColimitAlgHom c i (A := D)).comp
          (eᵢ.toAlgHom.restrictScalars R) =
        (e.toAlgHom.restrictScalars R).comp
          (filteredTensorToColimitAlgHom c i (A := B)) ∧
      (filteredTensorToColimitAlgHom c i (A := B)).comp
          (eᵢ.symm.toAlgHom.restrictScalars R) =
        (e.symm.toAlgHom.restrictScalars R).comp
          (filteredTensorToColimitAlgHom c i (A := D))

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.exists_tensorProduct_algHom_stage_of_filteredColimit
statement:
theorem exists_tensorProduct_algHom_stage_of_filteredColimit
    {R B D : Type u} [CommRing R] [CommRing B] [CommRing D]
    [Algebra R B] [Algebra R D]
    [Algebra.FinitePresentation R B]
    {J : Type u} [SmallCategory J] [IsFiltered J]
    (F : J ⥤ Under (CommRingCat.of R))
    (c : Cocone F) (hc : IsColimit c)
    (f : (c.pt ⊗[R] B) →ₐ[c.pt] (c.pt ⊗[R] D)) :
    ∃ (i : J) (fᵢ : (F.obj i ⊗[R] B) →ₐ[F.obj i] (F.obj i ⊗[R] D)),
      (filteredTensorToColimitAlgHom c i (A := D)).comp (fᵢ.restrictScalars R) =
        (f.restrictScalars R).comp
          (filteredTensorToColimitAlgHom c i (A := B))

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.exists_tensorProduct_family_eq_stage_of_filteredColimit
statement:
theorem exists_tensorProduct_family_eq_stage_of_filteredColimit
    {R B : Type u} [CommRing R] [CommRing B] [Algebra R B]
    {J : Type u} [SmallCategory J] [IsFiltered J]
    (F : J ⥤ Under (CommRingCat.of R))
    (c : Cocone F) (hc : IsColimit c) (k : J)
    {ι : Type*} [Finite ι] (x y : ι → (F.obj k ⊗[R] B))
    (hxy : ∀ a, filteredTensorToColimitAlgHom c k (x a) =
      filteredTensorToColimitAlgHom c k (y a)) :
    ∃ (l : J) (u : k ⟶ l), ∀ a,
      Algebra.TensorProduct.map (CommRingCat.toAlgHom (F.map u)) (AlgHom.id R B) (x a) =
        Algebra.TensorProduct.map (CommRingCat.toAlgHom (F.map u)) (AlgHom.id R B) (y a)

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.tensorScalarExtendAlgHom_square
statement:
theorem tensorScalarExtendAlgHom_square
    {F : Type u} [CommRing F] [Algebra K F]
    (η : E →ₐ[K] T) (σ : T →ₐ[K] F)
    (f : (E ⊗[K] B) →ₐ[E] (E ⊗[K] D))
    (g : (F ⊗[K] B) →ₐ[F] (F ⊗[K] D))
    (h : (Algebra.TensorProduct.map (σ.comp η) (AlgHom.id K D)).comp
        (f.restrictScalars K) = (g.restrictScalars K).comp
          (Algebra.TensorProduct.map (σ.comp η) (AlgHom.id K B))) :
    (Algebra.TensorProduct.map σ (AlgHom.id K D)).comp
        ((tensorScalarExtendAlgHom η f).restrictScalars K) =
      (g.restrictScalars K).comp (Algebra.TensorProduct.map σ (AlgHom.id K B))

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.tensorScalarExtendAlgHom_tmul
statement:
theorem tensorScalarExtendAlgHom_tmul (η : E →ₐ[K] T)
    (f : (E ⊗[K] B) →ₐ[E] (E ⊗[K] D)) (t : T) (b : B) :
    tensorScalarExtendAlgHom η f (t ⊗ₜ[K] b) =
      t • Algebra.TensorProduct.map η (AlgHom.id K D) (f ((1 : E) ⊗ₜ[K] b))

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.Inertia.normalizationPullback_conjugates_endomorphism
statement:
theorem normalizationPullback_conjugates_endomorphism [IsIso (f.normalizationPullback g)]
    (σ : X ⟶ X) (hσ : σ ≫ f = f) :
    normalizationEndomorphism (pullback.snd f g)
        (pullbackEndomorphism f g σ hσ)
        (pullbackEndomorphism_snd f g σ hσ) =
      f.normalizationPullback g ≫
        pullbackEndomorphism f.fromNormalization g
          (normalizationEndomorphism f σ hσ)
          (normalizationEndomorphism_fromNormalization f σ hσ) ≫
        inv (f.normalizationPullback g)

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.Inertia.normalizationPullback_endomorphism
statement:

theorem normalizationPullback_endomorphism
    (σ : X ⟶ X) (hσ : σ ≫ f = f) :

        (pullbackEndomorphism f g σ hσ)
        (pullbackEndomorphism_snd f g σ hσ) ≫
      f.normalizationPullback g =
    f.normalizationPullback g ≫
      pullbackEndomorphism f.fromNormalization g
        (normalizationEndomorphism f σ hσ)
        (normalizationEndomorphism_fromNormalization f σ hσ)

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.Inertia.normalizationPullback_fixes_point_iff

theorem normalizationPullback_fixes_point_iff [IsIso (f.normalizationPullback g)]
    {T : Scheme.{u}} (z : T ⟶ f.normalization) (y : T ⟶ Y)
    (hzy : z ≫ f.fromNormalization = y ≫ g)
    (σ : X ⟶ X) (hσ : σ ≫ f = f) :
    (pullback.lift z y hzy ≫ inv (f.normalizationPullback g)) ≫
        normalizationEndomorphism (pullback.snd f g)
          (pullbackEndomorphism f g σ hσ)
          (pullbackEndomorphism_snd f g σ hσ) =
      pullback.lift z y hzy ≫ inv (f.normalizationPullback g) ↔
    z ≫ normalizationEndomorphism f σ hσ = z

theorem affineMorphismNormalizationIso_fixes_iff

    (sigma : A ≅ A) (hsigma : sigma.hom ≫ f = f)
    {T : Scheme.{u}} (z : T ⟶ f.normalization) :
    let : Algebra R Γ(A, ⊤) := affineMorphismAlgebra R f
    (z ≫ (affineMorphismNormalizationIso R f).hom) ≫
        affineNormalizationDeck R Γ(A, ⊤) (affineMorphismAlgEquiv R f sigma hsigma) =

statement:

    [IsFractionRing B L] [IsIntegrallyClosed B]

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.Kummer.exists_finiteEtale_unitAbsorption_uniformizerRadical
statement:
theorem exists_finiteEtale_unitAbsorption_uniformizerRadical
    {K : Type u} {L : Type w} [Field K] [Field L] [Algebra K L]
    (base : DVF.{u, v} K) (target : DVF.{w, x} L)
    [base.valuation.HasExtension target.valuation]
    [CharZero base.residueField] :
    let n := ramificationIndex base target
    exists (varpi : base.valuationSubring) (pi : target.valuationSubring)
      (unit : target.valuationSubringˣ)
      (delta alpha : AlgebraicClosure L)
      (factorEquiv :
        AdjoinRoot (minpoly L delta) ≃ₐ[L]
          IntermediateField.adjoin L ({delta} : Set (AlgebraicClosure L)))
      (radicalEquiv :
        AdjoinRoot (X ^ n - C (varpi : K)) ≃ₐ[K]
          IntermediateField.adjoin K ({alpha} : Set (AlgebraicClosure L))),
      base.valuation.IsUniformizer (varpi : K) ∧
        target.valuation.IsUniformizer (pi : L) ∧
          Prime varpi ∧
            integerMap base target varpi =
              (unit : target.valuationSubring) * pi ^ n ∧
              Algebra.Etale target.valuationSubring
                (AdjoinRoot
                  (X ^ n - C (unit : target.valuationSubring))) ∧
                Module.Finite target.valuationSubring
                  (AdjoinRoot
                    (X ^ n - C (unit : target.valuationSubring))) ∧
                  delta ^ n = algebraMap L (AlgebraicClosure L) (unit : L) ∧
                    minpoly L delta ∣ X ^ n - C (unit : L) ∧
                      IsSeparable L delta ∧
                        alpha = delta * algebraMap L (AlgebraicClosure L) (pi : L) ∧
                          alpha ^ n =
                            algebraMap K (AlgebraicClosure L) (varpi : K) ∧
                            factorEquiv (AdjoinRoot.root (minpoly L delta)) =
                              IntermediateField.AdjoinSimple.gen L delta ∧
                              radicalEquiv
                                  (AdjoinRoot.root (X ^ n - C (varpi : K))) =
                                IntermediateField.AdjoinSimple.gen K alpha

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.Kummer.exists_finiteEtale_integralFactor_of_pow_eq_unit
statement:
theorem exists_finiteEtale_integralFactor_of_pow_eq_unit
    {B : Type u} {L : Type v} {Omega : Type w}
    [CommRing B] [IsDomain B] [IsIntegrallyClosed B]
    [Field L] [Field Omega]
    [Algebra B L] [IsFractionRing B L]
    [Algebra L Omega] [Algebra B Omega]
    [IsScalarTower B L Omega]
    {n : Nat} (hn : 0 < n) (hnUnit : IsUnit (n : B))
    (unit : Bˣ) (delta : Omega)
    (hdelta : delta ^ n =
      algebraMap L Omega (algebraMap B L (unit : B))) :
    ∃ (q : B[X])
      (factorEquiv :
        AdjoinRoot (q.map (algebraMap B L)) ≃ₐ[L]
          IntermediateField.adjoin L ({delta} : Set Omega)),
      q.Monic ∧
        q.map (algebraMap B L) = minpoly L delta ∧
          q ∣ X ^ n - C (unit : B) ∧
            Algebra.Etale B (AdjoinRoot q) ∧
              Module.Finite B (AdjoinRoot q) ∧
                factorEquiv (AdjoinRoot.root (q.map (algebraMap B L))) =
                  IntermediateField.AdjoinSimple.gen L delta

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.Kummer.exists_finiteEtale_unitAbsorption_actualCompositum
statement:
theorem exists_finiteEtale_unitAbsorption_actualCompositum
    {K : Type u} {L : Type v} [Field K] [Field L] [Algebra K L]
    (base : DVF.{u, w} K) (target : DVF.{v, x} L)
    [base.valuation.HasExtension target.valuation]
    [CharZero base.residueField] :
    let n := ramificationIndex base target
    ∃ (varpi : base.valuationSubring) (pi : target.valuationSubring)
      (unit : target.valuationSubringˣ)
      (delta alpha : AlgebraicClosure L) (q : target.valuationSubring[X])
      (unitFactorEquiv :
        AdjoinRoot (q.map (algebraMap target.valuationSubring L)) ≃ₐ[L]
          IntermediateField.adjoin L ({delta} : Set (AlgebraicClosure L)))
      (radicalEquiv :
        AdjoinRoot (X ^ n - C (varpi : K)) ≃ₐ[K]
          IntermediateField.adjoin K ({alpha} : Set (AlgebraicClosure L))),
      base.valuation.IsUniformizer (varpi : K) ∧
        target.valuation.IsUniformizer (pi : L) ∧
          integerMap base target varpi =
            (unit : target.valuationSubring) * pi ^ n ∧
            delta ^ n = algebraMap L (AlgebraicClosure L) (unit : L) ∧
              alpha = delta * algebraMap L (AlgebraicClosure L) (pi : L) ∧
                alpha ^ n =
                  algebraMap K (AlgebraicClosure L) (varpi : K) ∧
                  q.Monic ∧
                    q.map (algebraMap target.valuationSubring L) =
                      minpoly L delta ∧
                      q ∣ X ^ n - C (unit : target.valuationSubring) ∧
                        Algebra.Etale target.valuationSubring (AdjoinRoot q) ∧
                          Module.Finite target.valuationSubring (AdjoinRoot q) ∧
                            (IntermediateField.adjoin L
                                ({delta} : Set (AlgebraicClosure L))).restrictScalars K =
                              (IsScalarTower.toAlgHom K L
                                  (AlgebraicClosure L)).fieldRange ⊔
                                IntermediateField.adjoin K
                                  ({alpha} : Set (AlgebraicClosure L)) ∧
                              unitFactorEquiv
                                  (AdjoinRoot.root
                                    (q.map
                                      (algebraMap target.valuationSubring L))) =
                                IntermediateField.AdjoinSimple.gen L delta ∧
                                radicalEquiv
                                    (AdjoinRoot.root
                                      (X ^ n - C (varpi : K))) =
                                  IntermediateField.AdjoinSimple.gen K alpha

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.Kummer.exists_finiteEtale_unitFactor_for_prescribed_uniformizerRoot
statement:
theorem exists_finiteEtale_unitFactor_for_prescribed_uniformizerRoot
    {K : Type u} {L : Type v} [Field K] [Field L] [Algebra K L]
    (base : DVF.{u, w} K) (target : DVF.{v, x} L)
    [base.valuation.HasExtension target.valuation]
    [CharZero base.residueField]
    (varpi : base.valuationSubring) (pi : target.valuationSubring)
    (unit : target.valuationSubringˣ)
    (hpi : target.valuation.IsUniformizer (pi : L))
    (hdecomp :
      integerMap base target varpi =
        (unit : target.valuationSubring) *
          pi ^ ramificationIndex base target)
    (alpha : AlgebraicClosure L)
    (halphaPow :
      alpha ^ ramificationIndex base target =
        algebraMap K (AlgebraicClosure L) (varpi : K)) :
    ∃ (delta : AlgebraicClosure L) (q : target.valuationSubring[X])
      (unitFactorEquiv :
        AdjoinRoot (q.map (algebraMap target.valuationSubring L)) ≃ₐ[L]
          IntermediateField.adjoin L ({delta} : Set (AlgebraicClosure L)))
      (radicalToUnitFactor :
        AdjoinRoot
            (X ^ ramificationIndex base target - C varpi) →ₐ[base.valuationSubring]
          AdjoinRoot q),
      delta ^ ramificationIndex base target =
          algebraMap L (AlgebraicClosure L) (unit : L) ∧
        alpha = delta * algebraMap L (AlgebraicClosure L) (pi : L) ∧
          q.Monic ∧
            q.map (algebraMap target.valuationSubring L) = minpoly L delta ∧
              q ∣ X ^ ramificationIndex base target -
                C (unit : target.valuationSubring) ∧
                Algebra.Etale target.valuationSubring (AdjoinRoot q) ∧
                  Module.Finite target.valuationSubring (AdjoinRoot q) ∧
                    (IntermediateField.adjoin L
                        ({delta} : Set (AlgebraicClosure L))).restrictScalars K =
                      (IsScalarTower.toAlgHom K L
                          (AlgebraicClosure L)).fieldRange ⊔
                        IntermediateField.adjoin K
                          ({alpha} : Set (AlgebraicClosure L)) ∧
                      unitFactorEquiv
                          (AdjoinRoot.root
                            (q.map (algebraMap target.valuationSubring L))) =
                        IntermediateField.AdjoinSimple.gen L delta ∧
                        radicalToUnitFactor
                            (AdjoinRoot.root
                              (X ^ ramificationIndex base target - C varpi)) =
                          AdjoinRoot.root q *
                            algebraMap target.valuationSubring
                              (AdjoinRoot q) pi

    (P : Ideal A) [P.IsPrime]

    (f : Localization.AtPrime P)
    (hAway :
      let : Algebra (Localization.AtPrime P) L :=
        localizationAtPrimeToExtensionAlgebra (K := K) (L := L) P
      let : IsScalarTower A (Localization.AtPrime P) L :=
        localizationAtPrimeToExtension_isScalarTower
          (K := K) (L := L) P
      let q := localizedNormalizationPrime (K := K) (L := L) P Q
      let : q.IsMaximal :=
        localizedNormalizationPrime_isMaximal (K := K) (L := L) P Q
      let : q.IsPrime := (inferInstance : q.IsMaximal).isPrime
      IsAwayMapEtale (R := Localization.AtPrime P)
        (D := Localization.AtPrime q) f) :
    let : Algebra (Localization.AtPrime P) L :=
      localizationAtPrimeToExtensionAlgebra (K := K) (L := L) P
    let : IsScalarTower A (Localization.AtPrime P) L :=
      localizationAtPrimeToExtension_isScalarTower
        (K := K) (L := L) P
    let : Algebra (Localization.AtPrime P) (Localization.AtPrime Q) :=
      Localization.AtPrime.algebraOfLiesOver P Q
    RingHom.Etale
      (R := Localization.Away f)
      (S := Localization.Away
        (algebraMap (Localization.AtPrime P) (Localization.AtPrime Q) f))
      (Localization.awayMap
        (algebraMap (Localization.AtPrime P) (Localization.AtPrime Q)) f)

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.Purity.tensorComplexZeroIso_associator_hom
statement:
theorem tensorComplexZeroIso_associator_hom
    (K L B : CochainComplex (ModuleCat.{u} R) ℕ) :
    ((tensorComplexZeroIso K L).hom ▷ B.X 0) ≫
      (tensorComplexZeroIso (HomologicalComplex.tensorObj K L) B).hom ≫
      (HomologicalComplex.associator K L B).hom.f 0 =
    (α_ (K.X 0) (L.X 0) (B.X 0)).hom ≫
      (K.X 0 ◁ (tensorComplexZeroIso L B).hom) ≫
      (tensorComplexZeroIso K (HomologicalComplex.tensorObj L B)).hom

    (tensorComplexZeroIso K L).hom ≫ (HomologicalComplex.tensorHom f g).f 0 =
      (f.f 0 ⊗ₘ g.f 0) ≫ (tensorComplexZeroIso K' L').hom

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.Purity.tensorComplexZeroIso_inv_naturality

theorem tensorComplexZeroIso_inv_naturality

    (HomologicalComplex.tensorHom f g).f 0 ≫ (tensorComplexZeroIso K' L').inv =
      (tensorComplexZeroIso K L).inv ≫ (f.f 0 ⊗ₘ g.f 0)

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.derivedExtConnectingMap_naturality
statement:
theorem derivedExtConnectingMap_naturality
    {S₁ S₂ : ShortComplex C}
    (h₁ : S₁.ShortExact) (h₂ : S₂.ShortExact) (f : S₁ ⟶ S₂)
    (Y : C) (n₀ n₁ : ℕ) (h : 1 + n₀ = n₁) :
    AddCommGrpCat.ofHom (h₂.extClass.precomp Y h) ≫
        derivedExtContravariantMap f.τ₃ Y n₁ =
      derivedExtContravariantMap f.τ₁ Y n₀ ≫
        AddCommGrpCat.ofHom (h₁.extClass.precomp Y h)

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.derivedExtContravariantMap_comp
statement:
@[reassoc]
theorem derivedExtContravariantMap_comp
    {X₁ X₂ X₃ : C} (f : X₁ ⟶ X₂) (g : X₂ ⟶ X₃)
    (Y : C) (n : ℕ) :
    derivedExtContravariantMap g Y n ≫
        derivedExtContravariantMap f Y n =
      derivedExtContravariantMap (f ≫ g) Y n

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.derivedExtContravariantMap_id
statement:
@[simp]
theorem derivedExtContravariantMap_id (X Y : C) (n : ℕ) :

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.derivedExtContravariantMap_square
statement:
theorem derivedExtContravariantMap_square
    {X₁ X₂ X₁' X₂' : C}
    (a : X₁ ⟶ X₂) (b : X₁' ⟶ X₂')
    (f₁ : X₁ ⟶ X₁') (f₂ : X₂ ⟶ X₂')
    (hsq : f₁ ≫ b = a ≫ f₂) (Y : C) (n : ℕ) :
    AddCommGrpCat.ofHom
          ((CategoryTheory.Abelian.Ext.mk₀ b).precomp Y (zero_add n)) ≫
        derivedExtContravariantMap f₁ Y n =
      derivedExtContravariantMap f₂ Y n ≫
        AddCommGrpCat.ofHom
          ((CategoryTheory.Abelian.Ext.mk₀ a).precomp Y (zero_add n))

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.derivedExtContravariantSequenceDiagram_obj_exact
statement:
theorem derivedExtContravariantSequenceDiagram_obj_exact
    (F : D ⥤ ShortComplex C) (hF : ∀ d, (F.obj d).ShortExact)
    (Y : C) (n₀ n₁ : ℕ) (h : 1 + n₀ = n₁) (d : Dᵒᵖ) :

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.derivedExtContravariantSequenceMap_comp
statement:
@[reassoc]
theorem derivedExtContravariantSequenceMap_comp
    {S₁ S₂ S₃ : ShortComplex C}

    (f : S₁ ⟶ S₂) (g : S₂ ⟶ S₃)
    (Y : C) (n₀ n₁ : ℕ) (h : 1 + n₀ = n₁) :
    derivedExtContravariantSequenceMap h₂ h₃ g Y n₀ n₁ h ≫
        derivedExtContravariantSequenceMap h₁ h₂ f Y n₀ n₁ h =
      derivedExtContravariantSequenceMap h₁ h₃ (f ≫ g) Y n₀ n₁ h

theorem derivedExtContravariantSequenceMap_id

statement:
theorem derivedExtContravariantMap_covariantConnecting
    {X X' : C} {S : ShortComplex C} (hS : S.ShortExact)
    (f : X ⟶ X') (n₀ n₁ : ℕ) (h : n₀ + 1 = n₁) :
    AddCommGrpCat.ofHom (hS.extClass.postcomp X' h) ≫
        derivedExtContravariantMap f S.X₁ n₁ =
      derivedExtContravariantMap f S.X₃ n₀ ≫
        AddCommGrpCat.ofHom (hS.extClass.postcomp X h)

        derivedExtContravariantMap f Y' n =
      derivedExtContravariantMap f Y n ≫
        AddCommGrpCat.ofHom
          ((CategoryTheory.Abelian.Ext.mk₀ g).postcomp X (add_zero n))
